title: Životni ciklus: nadogradnja, etcd backup/restore, certifikati
summary: Nadogradnja kubeadm klastera korak po korak, etcd backup sa etcdctl i restore sa etcdutl, provjera i obnova certifikata te drain/cordon za održavanje čvorova.
summary_en: Upgrading a kubeadm cluster step by step, etcd backup with etcdctl and restore with etcdutl, checking and renewing certificates, and drain/cordon for node maintenance.
